title: Fighter pilot from Chile meets an object clocked at 25,000 km/h

tellings.quote: One of them, for example, was a pilot that was flying from Chile to Brazil, flying a fighter jet.

plain: In the 1980s, a fighter pilot flying from Chile to Brazil is said to have met an object measured at 25,000 kilometres an hour, far faster than any known aircraft. The story is told by Aldo Rebelo, a former defense minister of Brazil, as one of the cases from his country he holds to be real.
